method.description: Durably enqueue a message or accept a worker report/heartbeat. Raw payload and structured fields are mutually exclusive; outcome is valid only for worker_done. Group targets accept only group-safe message types and provider IDs, never display titles.

providerId.description: Published provider identity, not a provider display name or session title.

payload.description: Any JSON value; mutually exclusive with taskId, dispatchId, outcome, filesModified, reportPath and phase.

outcome.description: Only valid for a worker_done report.

terminal.description: Optional equality assertion for the authenticated session; never authority.

result.description: Native SendResult union: kind=message has threadId; kind=worker_report has report; kind=heartbeat has heartbeat.

sender.description: MailboxAddress: run, dispatch, or session discriminant with its matching ID.

mailbox.description: Resolved MailboxAddress: run, dispatch, or session discriminant with its matching ID.

threadId.description: Thread ID or null for non-threaded sends.

report.description: WorkerReportResult: accepted/duplicate includes task, dispatch and worker; rejected includes reason and audited=true.

heartbeat.description: HeartbeatResult: accepted has lastHeartbeatAt; rejected has reason and null lastHeartbeatAt.

method.description: Read or consume the caller's mailbox. Default/consume acknowledges one durable FIFO delivery; peek and all are read-only unless ackDeliveryId is supplied. Wait is connection-aware and returns the full FIFO batch even when types filter the wake condition.

ackDeliveryId.description: Acknowledge this durable Delivery before reading/waiting; this is mutating in every mode.

terminal.description: Optional equality assertion for the authenticated caller session; never authority.

from.description: Optional equality assertion for the authenticated caller session; never authority.

limit.description: Applies to peek/all; consume always returns its durable batch.

requestId.description: Required for consume or an acknowledgement.

contractVersion.description: Required for consume or an acknowledgement.

result.description: CheckObservationResult plus mode. Consume adds deliveryId and replayed plus a mutation receipt. Peek/all never consume and have no receipt unless ackDeliveryId was used.

runId.description: Run ID or null when no Run mailbox applies.

sender.description: MailboxAddress: run, dispatch, or session discriminant with its matching ID.

mailbox.description: Resolved MailboxAddress: run, dispatch, or session discriminant with its matching ID.

deliveryId.description: Delivery ID or null; present for consume.

mutation.description: Present for consume and for ackDeliveryId in peek/all.

method.description: Answer a pending question or send a threaded ordinary reply to one message.

terminal.description: Optional equality assertion for the authenticated session; never authority.

sender.description: MailboxAddress discriminant with its matching ID.

method.description: Read host-wide message history without consuming or acknowledging messages; terminal scopes history to that recipient session.

terminal.description: Optional recipient session ID; this is an inbox filter, not caller authority.

result.description: full=true returns complete MessageRow objects; without full, body and payload may be omitted.

sender.description: MailboxAddress discriminant with its matching ID.

payload.description: Optional JSON value or null in a non-full InboxMessageRow.

method.description: Create a resumable question or wait on its existing message ID. question and messageId are exclusive; options apply only to a new question; to is limited to the owning Run. timeoutMs is clamped to 0 through 1,800,000 ms.

to.description: Only the owning Run address {kind:run,runId} is valid.

from.description: Optional equality assertion for the authenticated session; never authority.

terminal.description: Optional equality assertion for the authenticated session; never authority.

result.description: Native AskResult union. answered has a string answer and answerMessageId; timedOut/cancelled/connectionLost have answer=null. All variants preserve the same question ID for resume.
